specification: For all eight feature combinations: the three lifecycle and resource claims are native exactly when native_scene is on, cpu_rgba8_surface exactly when cpu_surface is on, gpu_texture_view exactly when gpu_texture is on, gated otherwise. Surface acquire, present and vsync are host owned, hardware present is unverified, device-loss recovery and the system host are unsupported, whatever the features.
behavior_change: compiled() now reports native_contract for the lifecycle, DPI and font claims when native-blitz-pending is on; it reported feature_gated, contradicting docs/host-rendering.md
cpu_rgba8_surface follows cpu-pending, the cfg its entries use; under gpu-pending alone it reported feature_gated although the entries compiled
gpu_device_loss_recovery is unsupported instead of unverified, because no device-loss code exists; unverified means implemented without acceptance evidence
native() returns the same report as compiled()
assumptions: Verus, Z3 and the Rust compiler
cfg! values reach for_features through compiled(), which is checked by tests, not proved

Verus+Z3.model_note: The count includes the re-verified dependencies.
